text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The rain just won't stop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rain had been falling continuously
for 
several days. The sound of rain beating 
against the roof constantly echoed deep 
within my ears.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Intermittently... continuously... That 
sound obstructs my thoughts, and the 
stifling humidity dulls my tactile 
senses...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I have completed all of the menu you gave 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before we knew it, we were the only ones 
left in the gymnasium."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What shall we do next?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
We still have a little more time, 
however...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hint of fatigue could be seen on Still 
in Love's face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just fatigue from training.
With 
this rain, all the Umamusume had gloomy 
looks on their faces. Right now—
choice_data_list: Let's take a break without pushing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —No.
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Y o u ' r e w r o n g

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, is something the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I shake my head.
My mind just won't clear 
up... With my thoughts shrouded in fog, I 
desperately search for words."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: C  o  n  t  i  n  u  e

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Let's push a little 
further.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It's over...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is exhausted.
If she doesn't 
rest soon, it will affect her tomorrow. 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: K  e  e  p     g  o  i  n  g
K  e  e  p     g  o  i  n  g

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Under... stood...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *pant*... haa... ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love has reached her limit. I 
can't let her continue any longer. That's 
why—
choice_data_list: (Still... she can barely stay on h...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: D O N ' T S T O P ! !

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm quite all right...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay... I can... push myself... even 
harder...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: So... don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—Tell me your true desires... just as 
they are.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then—the sound of rain abruptly 
stopped.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is already completely 
exhausted. I must not burden her any 
further... That is the rational choice to 
make right now.
choice_data_list: Sorry, let's call it a day after a...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Sorry, I... wasn't in my right mind...
Sorry, I... what was I thinking...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm all right. Please, don't blame 
yourself like that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"With this, I'm sure... I must have grown 
just a little bit stronger."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Besides,
with this rain... it wouldn't be 
surprising if Trainer's thoughts were 
clouded..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Let's head back. ...I'll go get changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Really?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I glance up at the ceiling. The rain has 
completely stopped, and through the 
window—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A red full moon was peeking through.
